goal_outcome: Redundancy and major tracking-interface bottleneck confirmed on fixed subsets; NMS improves tracking but fails the preregistered calibration Novel recall safety gate. No full-Val promotion.

calibration.selection: highest semantic score among IoU>=0.5 candidates per GT; evaluator-only, optimistic mapping fit on TAO Val

confirmation.selection: highest semantic score among IoU>=0.5 candidates per GT; evaluator-only, optimistic mapping fit on TAO Val

semantic_diagnostics.interpretation: Prototype counts include both base and novel prototypes. Purity is conditional on GT-covered proposals and can be high with fragmented prototypes; frozen Hungarian mapping is fit on TAO Val and these figures are evaluator-only optimistic diagnostics.

recommended_operating_point.official_full_val_baseline: Retain frozen FG-0 as historical full-Val incumbent; no NMS full-Val result is available or claimed.
recommended_operating_point.tracking_only_diagnostic: Dedup-C: class-agnostic NMS IoU0.7, max100 with fixed FG-0 ByteTrack; useful reproducible diagnostic, fails calibration Novel recall safety.
recommended_operating_point.next_research: Stop expanding PANDAS. Return to fixed physical tracker + common features -> Nearest / DP-Means / PHE / TrackOCD.
